semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides critical components for vacuum systems and ultra-pure gas systems used in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Suzhou Magnox Hygienic Materials Co.,Ltd. specializes in manufacturing components essential for vacuum and gas systems in semiconductor production. Their offerings include ultra-high vacuum pipes, fittings, valves, and customized vacuum chambers, as well as ultra-high purity components for gas systems.
capabilities: Ultra-high purity gas pipelines and control panels
